item.title: Fintech startup Acme raises $25 Mn in Series B led by Growth Fund
item.description: Bengaluru-based Acme, which offers credit lines to small merchants, has raised $25 Mn in a Series B round led by Growth Fund, with participation from existing investors. The company will use the money to expand to 50 cities.

item.title: RBI keeps repo rate unchanged at 5.5%, retains neutral stance
item.description: The Monetary Policy Committee voted to keep the repo rate unchanged and said inflation is expected to stay within the target band.

item.title: Top 5 stocks to buy this week for big gains
Tata Steel signs Rs 28,000 crore deal with APL Apollo for two units
item.description: The deal covers two plants and will expand Tata Steel's downstream tubes business.
